title: UPC-A checker
request: UPC-A checker. The user sends a UPC-A code. If it is not exactly 12 digits reply 'INVALID UPC: need 12 digits'. Otherwise compute 3 x (sum of digits in positions 1,3,5,7,9,11) + (sum of digits in positions 2,4,6,8,10); the check digit is (10 - total mod 10) mod 10 and must equal digit 12. Reply 'VALID UPC' or 'INVALID UPC'.
